review_notes: I read all of IrredBase.lean and grepped for its helper names across the repo. `irredFacts` repeats a short `allLt_spec` plus `simp` pattern for h4 and h6. That is only a couple of lines, so I did not report it. `neg_eq_self'` and `sub_eq_add'` also exist in other files, but with different types and hypotheses (an abstract `ZMod 2`-module, `F4`, and so on). A shared lemma there would need a different statement, so I left them out. `bvec_one_shiftLeft22` repeats `bvec_one_shiftLeft` from Co2/MatrixActionBase.lean at width 24, but each is a two-line proof, so it is too small to report. The reportable item is `decW_one_shiftLeft`, which has the same statement and essentially the same proof in three files. I read all three copies and the import chains of the two TwoA files. The main uncertainty is the explicit `open ... (decW_one_shiftLeft ...)` list in CFSG/Monster/B/CTIB/TableSixLength.lean line 50. It would need adjusting if the TwoA copies are removed. I could not compile anything.

theorem decW_one_shiftLeft (t : Fin 22) : decW (1 <<< (t : ℕ)) = qbW t := by
  rw [decW, Finset.sum_eq_single t]
findings.problem: The same lemma, `decW (1 <<< t) = qbW t`, is proved three times with the same `Finset.sum_eq_single` / `testBit_one_shiftLeft` / `decide_eq_true` / `decide_eq_false` case split. The copies are in CFSG.Monster.B.Co2 (this file), CFSG.Monster.B.TwoA.Co2Inv (RowsBase.lean) and CFSG.Monster.B.TwoA.Unitary (ActionBase.lean). The statement depends only on `decW` and `qbW`, both defined in Co2/MatrixWBase.lean. Both TwoA files already import that module transitively (via FrameBase and WActBase) and already `open CFSG.Monster.B.Co2`. The copies are only separate because each lemma is declared in the first file that needed it. The same one-hot sum pattern is repeated again for `dec_one_shiftLeft` in Co2/MatrixActionBase.lean. Any change to `decW` or to `testBit_one_shiftLeft` must be fixed in three places, and the duplicate names make `open` lists such as the one in TableSixLength.lean ambiguous.
findings.proposed_change: Keep one copy next to `decW` in CFSG/Monster/B/Co2/MatrixWBase.lean (after `decW_zero`, around line 107), with the statement unchanged: `theorem decW_one_shiftLeft (t : Fin 22) : decW (1 <<< (t : ℕ)) = qbW t`. Use the proof from this file: `rw [decW, Finset.sum_eq_single t]`, then one case for `s = t` that rewrites with `bvec_apply, testBit_one_shiftLeft, decide_eq_true rfl, ite_eq_left rfl, one_smul`, one case for `s ≠ t` with `decide_eq_false` and `zero_smul`, and `simp` for the missing-index case. `testBit_one_shiftLeft` is already in scope there, from MatrixActionBase, which MatrixWBase imports. Then delete the copies at TwoA/Co2Inv/RowsBase.lean lines 54–62 and TwoA/Unitary/ActionBase.lean lines 17–24. Their callers keep working unchanged, because both files `open CFSG.Monster.B.Co2` and import MatrixWBase transitively. These include `rowsEnd_idRows` (`← decW_one_shiftLeft`) and `wAct_alphaWordL_decW` in Action.lean. The one explicit import list that names `decW_one_shiftLeft` is `open CFSG.Monster.B.TwoA.Co2Inv (...)` at TableSixLength.lean line 50. That entry should be dropped, or the file should open `CFSG.Monster.B.Co2` instead. Co2/Irred.lean already uses the Co2 version and is unaffected.
findings.benefit: There is a single proof, placed next to the definition of `decW` and `qbW`. A reader no longer has to check whether three same-named lemmas in three namespaces are really identical. A future change to `decW` or `bvec` needs one proof update, and the `open` lists lose the duplicated name.
